species: Female emu (Dromaius novaehollandiae) drumming: a rolling series of deep booms made with her inflatable throat pouch, recorded at the Ruhr Zoo in Germany in 1984
note: From the Animal Sound Archive (Tierstimmenarchiv) of the Museum für Naturkunde Berlin. The 70 Hz high-pass removes measured low-frequency rumble and 50 Hz mains hum between the booms.
